units.source_text: 侍从近来容貌也衰减了。

en.t: The attendant, too, had lately lost some of her beauty.

units.source_text: 由于长年辛苦，身体甚是消瘦，然而风韵还很清雅。

en.t: Years of hardship had left her very thin, yet her grace was still refined and elegant.

units.source_text: 说句不客气的话：小姐应该和她交换个相貌才好。

en.t: To speak frankly, it would have been better if the young lady could have exchanged looks with her.

units.source_text: 姨母对末摘花开言道：“我们马上就要动身了。

en.t: The aunt began speaking to Suetsumuhana: "We are about to set out at once.

units.source_text: 你孤苦伶仃地独居在此，教我难于抛舍。

en.t: You live here all alone in such loneliness and hardship, and I find it hard to leave you behind.

units.source_text: 今天我是来迎接侍从的。

en.t: Today I have come to fetch the attendant.

units.source_text: 你讨厌我，不亲近我，片刻也不肯到我家来。

en.t: You dislike me, keep your distance from me, and will not come to my house even for a moment.

units.source_text: 但这个人请你允许我带去。

en.t: But please allow me to take this person with me.

units.source_text: 不过你在这里，这凄凉的日子怎么过呢？”

en.t: Still, if you remain here, how will you endure these desolate days?"

units.source_text: 说到这里，似乎应该滴下几点眼泪了。

en.t: Having said this much, she really ought to have shed a few tears.

units.source_text: 然而她正在预想此去前途的光荣，心中甚是欢欣，哪里挤得出眼泪呢？

en.t: But she was already imagining the glory that awaited her after leaving, and her heart was so delighted that no tears could possibly be forced out.

units.source_text: 她又说：“你家常陆亲王在世之时，嫌我丢了你们的脸，不要我上门，因此我们就疏远起来。

en.t: She went on: "When Prince Hitachi of your household was alive, he thought I would disgrace you and would not let me visit, so we became estranged.

units.source_text: 但我一向绝不介意。

en.t: But I have never minded it at all.

units.source_text: 后来呢，因为你身份高贵，骄傲自满，宿命又好，结识了源氏大将。

en.t: Later, because your rank was noble, you were proud and self-satisfied, and your fate was fortunate, you came to know General Genji.

units.source_text: 我这身份低贱的人就有所顾忌，不敢前来亲近，直到今朝。

en.t: Someone of lowly status like me felt constrained and did not dare come near you until this morning.

units.source_text: 然而人世之事，原无一定。

en.t: Yet the affairs of this world are never fixed.

units.source_text: 我这微不足道的人，现在反而安乐。

en.t: An insignificant person like me is now, on the contrary, living in comfort.

units.source_text: 而你这高不可攀的贵府，如今只落得悲惨荒凉，至于此极。

en.t: Meanwhile your once unapproachable noble house has now fallen into such utter misery and desolation.

units.source_text: 一向因为近在咫尺，虽然不常往来，亦可放心。

en.t: Until now, because we were so close by, I could feel at ease even though we did not often visit each other.

units.source_text: 现在即将远赴他乡，将你抛弃在此，心中甚是挂念呢！”

en.t: Now that I am about to go far away to another province, leaving you behind here weighs heavily on my heart!"
